observations: Photo 0 is the only photo: a white home game console with a three-layer stacked shape, sitting on cardboard boxes in a shop.
No brand, logo, model label or serial can be read on the console in photo 0; tiny marks on the front corner are illegible.
The top surface has a faint pink or red smudge or stain.
Two sealed boxes of third-party controllers are on top, printed 'Wireless Controller', 'X6' and 'FOR Switch/PS4/PC/Android'; they are not Sony controllers.
A UK-plug power cable and a second black cable, likely HDMI, are included.
The console is not shown powered on, and no screen, storage size or ports are shown.
The photo carries a 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'GAME ARENA OFFICAL' dealer watermark.

identity.kind: white home game console with two third-party wireless controllers, shape consistent with a PlayStation 4 Pro
read_from: photo 0 shape only, no legible label

claims.evidence: The three-layer shape in photo 0 fits a PS4 Pro, but no logo or CUH model label is legible; the label on the back or underside is missing.
No clip of the console powering on or running a game.

risks.risk: Model and storage not confirmed: may be a different console or a lower storage variant
risks.proof: Close-up of the model and serial label on the back or underside of the console, legible
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced as a PS4 Pro

risks.risk: Console does not power on, overheats, has a faulty disc drive or HDMI port
risks.proof: Clip of the console booting to the home screen, reading a disc and running a game, with a handwritten code in shot

risks.risk: Account or console banned, or locked to a previous owner
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > System > System Information and a clip of signing in to PlayStation Network

risks.risk: Controllers are third-party and no original Sony controller is included
risks.proof: Photo of every controller included, with its back label
risks.if_unproven: as console with third-party controllers only

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage, dented corners or a broken back panel
risks.proof: Photos of the back, sides and ports of the console

proof_requests: Close-up of the model and serial label on the back or underside of the console
Clip of the console powering on to the home screen and running a game, with a handwritten code in shot
Screenshot of System Information showing storage size and software version
Photos of the back panel, ports and all four sides
Photo of every controller and accessory included
response.reason: The console shape looks like a PS4 Pro, but no brand or model label is legible in the only photo, and the model sets the price, so the label shot is needed before even a worst case price.
